summary: Shotgun surgery cycle_telemetry in scan phase

delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm Shotgun Surgery: cycle_telemetry smell (planfile ticket PLF-043, dedupe key code2llm:smell:shotgun_surgery:src/koru/autonomy/phases/scan_phase.py:595) by renaming the generic telemetry-dict parameter 'cycle_telemetry' to stage-accurate names in each of the nine functions in src/koru/autonomy/phases/scan_phase.py that mutate it: rate_limit_skip_telemetry (_skip_scan_after_idle_for_rate_limit), create_failed_cooldown_skip_telemetry (_skip_scan_after_idle_for_create_failed_cooldown), duplicate_cooldown_skip_telemetry (_skip_scan_after_idle_for_duplicate_cooldown), idle_scan_result_telemetry (_record_scan_after_idle_result), code2llm_discovery_telemetry (_record_code2llm_discovery_telemetry), monag_discovery_telemetry (_record_monag_discovery_telemetry), nxdo_discovery_telemetry (_record_nxdo_discovery_telemetry), todo2code_discovery_telemetry (_record_todo2code_discovery_telemetry), code_change_autonomy_telemetry (_record_code_change_autonomy_telemetry). The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the group drops from 9 scopes to 0. The umbrella name cycle_telemetry stays in the four non-mutating pass-through scopes (handle_backlog_promotion_after_idle, handle_scan_after_idle, _run_idle_discovery_fallbacks, _run_scan_after_idle), which produce no mutation records and where it genuinely names the cycle-wide dict. Pure rename of parameters and their in-module call references; all call sites are positional, no behavior change.
nonGoals: No behavior, telemetry-key, decision or interface change
No restructuring into a telemetry recorder class or central writer (each stage writes disjoint keys for its own decision; the shared generic name was the defect, not a missing abstraction)
No rename of cycle_telemetry parameters in other modules or of the public entry-point parameters

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate parameter renames only, inside one module, following the accepted ticket-266 precedent for the identical smell class in cycle_skip_conditions.py. Every mutating helper names the telemetry view of the scan/idle stage it records; the umbrella name cycle_telemetry remains only in the four pass-through scopes, which produce no mutation records. Verified with the code2llm shotgun-surgery detector: baseline groups cycle_telemetry mutations in 9 scopes in the file (>= 5 threshold fires), after the rename no scope in the file mutates the name and no new (file, variable) group reaches the threshold.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the parameters are named cycle_telemetry again and the smell report returns.

commands: python3 -c "<standalone code2llm DFGExtractor + SmellDetector on plain /tmp copies of scan_phase.py, original vs renamed>"
validation.evidence: Deterministic ground truth on plain /tmp copies (never inside the registered worktree): the installed code2llm DFGExtractor plus the real SmellDetector run standalone on the single file reports 'Shotgun Surgery: cycle_telemetry' for the original content with exactly the 9 mutating scopes named in the ticket, and 0 mutating scopes for the renamed content, with the file's total mutation count unchanged (128) and no new shotgun entry; the separate pre-existing payload/outcome/state.telemetry_scan_after_idle_tickets_applied groups are untouched by design (minimal scope).

All listed suites pass unchanged in the ticket worktree (pure rename; every renamed scope is executed by existing tests asserting the same telemetry keys), and ruff reports zero errors on the touched file.
GOV-PASS 0 errors 0 warnings from the ticket worktree.
